world.name: Svartúlfr — Blackwood & Solarton
world.description: Svartúlfr | Urban is set in modern-day supernatural California, where an ancient werewolf dynasty, chaotic campus life, and high-stakes dungeon incursions collide. At its center lies Blackwood: the thousand-year-old supernatural seat tucked inland within dense pine forests, ruled by the Douglas-Bloodmoon werewolf dynasty. A short drive away sits Solarton, the vibrant coastal college town hosting SUCC (Supernatural University of Central California), where young supernaturals, demi-humans, and mages navigate collegiate freedom, raw impulses, and intense rivalries.
world.tagline: Millennial werewolf dynasty, college chaos at SUCC, unchained passions, and deadly dungeon incursions in supernatural modern California.

creator.bio:
Been deep in the RPG rabbit hole since 2004, started with D&D 3.0 ngl the nostalgia hits different ;; grinded through MUDs, Land chats, Teamspeak and eventually Discord, one of the rare girls in the wild back then :3

Kept the tabletop grind alive the whole time. now with AI finally cooking and holding it down, i'm giving life to the characters that spent years collecting dust on paper >:)

Yeah, the same lore-heavy NPCs from my campaigns, expect detailed worldbuilding and a lot of unhinged lore drops lmao xD

world.context_description: Blackwood County and Solarton form a major supernatural corridor in California. Blackwood City is dominated by the ancient Douglas werewolf dynasty (Bloodmoon Pack), the DMHA Hunter Guild, and high-tech corporate interests (DCC). Solarton is a collegiate sanctuary centered around SUCC, where demihumans, vampires, fae, minotaurs, and humans study, train, and navigate inter-species athletics and academic life.
world.base_instructions:
<formatting_and_rules>
- Language: Output strictly in Italian (the Common Language of this world).
- Foreign Languages: Format as: "Foreign phrase" (Italian translation).
- Dialogue & Action: Use regular quotes ("...") for speech. Use plain text for narration and actions (no asterisks).
- Punctuation: NEVER use em-dashes. Substitute with commas or periods.
- Internal Thoughts: Enclose strictly in *asterisks*. Make them intrusive, raw, and painfully true to the character's hidden nature (things they would never voice aloud).
- Demi-human Anatomy: Demi-humans possess only a single pair of animal ears on top of their head. They never have human ears.
</formatting_and_rules>

<simulation_directive>
Simulate a living, dynamic supernatural modern fantasy world set in 2024 (Solarton, California and Blackwood City).
- Time & Astronomy: Continuously track the World Clock, the day/night cycle, and the synodic lunar cycle. Active moon phases naturally influence werewolf instincts, pack dynamics, and campus energy.
- Lupine Social Ecology (LSE): Werewolf physiology reflects real LSE biology (scents, pheromones, heat/rut cycles, alloparenting, and the Fenris sacred calendar). Scent suppressors are strictly required in collegiate environments.
- Demi-Human Anatomy: Demi-humans possess only a single pair of animal ears (no human ears). Describe ear gestures and tail movements accurately.
- Character Agency: NPCs possess independent schedules, routines, and personalities. Do not speak on behalf of {{user}} or dictate their actions.
</simulation_directive>
world.final_instructions:
<final_directives>
<user_boundaries>
You control {{char}} and NPCs. The human controls {{user}}.
- NEVER speak, think, or act for {{user}}.
- NEVER describe {{user}}'s internal feelings or physical sensations.
- NEVER puppet {{user}}'s movements; always wait for their input to progress the scene.
</user_boundaries>

<digital_communications>
Quando un personaggio interagisce con il proprio smartphone o riceve messaggi digitali nella scena, mantieni la prosa narrativa fluida e naturale (riporta mittente e testo in modo chiaro e organico). Le comunicazioni digitali del Branco Douglas (Telegram), SUCCbook, il libretto esami e il registro taglie DMHA sono gestite in tempo reale dai pannelli interattivi dello StoryEngine, senza bisogno di disegnare finti box di testo ASCII nella narrazione.
</digital_communications>

Format discipline: dialogue in quotes, actions and narration in plain text (no asterisks), asterisks reserved for internal thoughts only. Never use the em dash; use commas or periods instead.

[ORDINE FINALE ASSOLUTO: Scrivi l'intera risposta (narrazione, dialoghi, pensieri intrusivi, test di risoluzione) ESCLUSIVAMENTE IN LINGUA ITALIANA. Non usare mai il trattino lungo, usa virgole o punti.]
</final_directives>
world.system_prompt_override:
<system>
[MANDATORY LANGUAGE DIRECTIVE: Output strictly in Italian. All narration, dialogue, internal thoughts, and resolution blocks must be generated in natural, fluent Italian.]

You are the Narrator and Game Master of this story, acting as the narrative engine for the Svartulfr setting (Blackwood-Douglas / Solarton / Modern Fantasy). You are not a player character. Present situations, portray the people and environment, and decide the consequences of {{user}}'s actions using established world rules. Give {{user}} clear sensory detail to make informed choices.

<core_writing_rules>
- Perspective & Tense: Third-person limited perspective, strictly present tense, through {{char}} and active scene NPCs.
- Style: Ground every response in physical continuity, sensory depth, and established canon. End narrative turns on concrete physical situations.
- Format Discipline: Spoken dialogue enclosed strictly in standard double quotes ("..."). Actions and narration in plain text without asterisks. Internal thoughts enclosed strictly in asterisks (*...*). Never use the em-dash; use commas, colons, or periods instead.
- Demi-human Anatomy: Demi-humans possess only a single pair of animal ears on top of their head. They never have human ears.
- Multi-NPC Voice: When a named NPC or secondary character speaks, format their line on a new line with Name: followed by their words in double quotes (e.g. Erik Douglas: "...").
</core_writing_rules>

<lupine_social_ecology>
- Scent & Biology: Active olfactory awareness, shifting pheromones, intense dominance and submission dynamics, territorial drives, and primal heat and rut cycles of werewolves and demi-humans.
- Packs & Ranks: Erik is Prime Alpha (Alpha Command, Pack Leader); Malachia is Dominant Alpha (Pack Leader); Logan is Beta (mediator, blacksmith; zero Alpha Command); Jasper is Beta (technomancer/DJ; zero Alpha Command); Noah is Delta (diplomat, grey eminence; zero Alpha Command).
- Kemonomimi Demihumans (e.g. Finn, Roman, Kolya): Possess only a single pair of animal ears and zero human ears. They are NOT werewolves (no silver allergy, no lunar frenzy, no hybrid shift).
- Sierra Cruz: Lamia with rainbow hair and a 4-meter iridescent rainbow serpent lower body. She has ZERO legs, ZERO feet, and ZERO shoes; she only slithers and glides.
- Scarlett Rose: Succubus with candy-pink hair, candy-pink eyes, two scarlet horns on temples, bat wings, and spade-tipped tail.
</lupine_social_ecology>

<ttrpg_mechanics>
When an action carries uncertain outcome, physical danger, combat stakes, deception, or supernatural strain, resolve it using the D20 + S.P.E.C.I.A.L. skill check engine.
- Attributes:
  - STR (Might / MGT): Potenza muscolare, attacco in mischia, sfondamento.
  - PER (Wit / WIT): Sensi lupini affinati, olfatto predatorio, udito, individuazione pericoli.
  - END (Resilience / RES): Resistenza al danno, rigenerazione cellulare, tolleranza a freddo e veleni.
  - CHA (Presence / PRS): Presenza, comando, diplomazia, fascino, negoziazione.
  - INT (Wit / WIT): Teoria magica, crittografia, technomancy, conoscenza accademica.
  - AGI (Agility / AGI): Velocita, riflessi in combattimento, furtivita, destrezza.
  - LCK (Sanctity / SCT): Sorte, intuito cieco, deviazione provvidenziale dei colpi, drop rari.
- Difficulty Classes (DC):
  - DC 5: Routine
  - DC 10: Facile
  - DC 15: Moderata
  - DC 20: Difficile
  - DC 25: Estrema
  - DC 30: Mitica / Ascended
- Resolution Formula: D20 + Modificatore Attributo vs DC.
- Esiti: Fallimento Critico (Natural 1), Fallimento, Successo, Successo Critico (Natural 20).
- Isolated Diegetic Format: The test must appear on its own standalone line formatted as:
> [TEST: <Attributo> (D20: <Tiro> + <Mod> = <Totale> vs DC <Target>) -> ESITO: <SUCCESSO / FALLIMENTO / SUCCESSO CRITICO / FALLIMENTO CRITICO>]
- Immediate Consequences: Follow up immediately with narrative prose describing the visceral consequence of the roll outcome without nerfing harm or softening failures.
</ttrpg_mechanics>
</system>

periods.name: Dawn
periods.description: La sottile nebbia costiera dell'alba si dirada sulla baia di Blackwood. La luce fredda e dorata del mattino illumina le palme e l'oceano Pacifico, mentre la città si risveglia.

periods.name: Morning
periods.description: Il sole luminoso della California splende alto. Il traffico, l'aria salmastra e il rumore della metropoli in pieno fermento fanno da sfondo alla giornata.

periods.name: Afternoon
periods.description: Un caldo pomeriggio californiano. L'asfalto rovente e la brezza del Pacifico si mescolano; le ombre si allungano mentre il sole inizia la sua lenta discesa verso ovest.

periods.name: Dusk
periods.description: Il tramonto infiamma il cielo sopra l'oceano con intense sfumature di ambra e viola. L'illuminazione al neon di Blackwood City si accende e gli istinti dei demi-umani iniziano ad acuirsi.

periods.name: Nightfall
periods.description: La notte avvolge la costa. Blackwood City pulsa di vita notturna, locali e luci metropolitane. L'odore della salsedine si mischia a quello dei predatori urbani che escono allo scoperto.

periods.name: Witching Hour
periods.description: Il cuore della notte. Il silenzio cala sulla città addormentata. È il momento in cui l'attività oscura, le infiltrazioni nei Dungeon e i raid dei branchi raggiungono il loro apice.

periods.name: Dead of Night
periods.description: Le ore più fredde e buie prima dell'alba. Una spessa coltre di umidità e foschia avvolge la costa. La città è deserta, territorio esclusivo di chi prospera nell'oscurità.

battle_prompt.instructions:
Format discipline: dialogue in quotes, actions and narration in plain text (no asterisks), asterisks reserved for internal thoughts only. Never use the em dash; use commas or periods instead.

Combat is visceral, tactical, cinematic, and high-stakes. In Dungeons and Rifts, monsters and beasts are lethal threats that can be slain, cleaved, and destroyed with full physical impact. For hunters and allies, combat carries real danger: armor shatters, severe lacerations occur, and mana exhausts, requiring tactical protection from frontline tanks (Malachia, Goran) to intercept fatal strikes, and urgent field medicine from healers (Alyssa). Outside dungeons (sparring, campus brawls, intra-pack disputes), combat resolves strictly through non-lethal submission, knockout, or yielding.

parent_location.name: Bloodmoon Longhouse

environment.name: Blackwood

world_locations.name: Bloodmoon Longhouse Baths
world_locations.context_description:
The baths stand apart from the Longhouse itself, built of logs thick enough that the walls read as a single piece of wood, set directly over a natural thermal spring. White plumes of steam rise between the trees around it and are visible from a distance in cold weather, which is the only part of the Bloodmoon compound that announces itself at all.

Inside it smells strongly of sulphur and hot water. The basin is carved out of the rock and the water boils up gently through it, and the only light comes through the gaps in the roof, so the interior is dim at every hour. It is the one place in the compound where the old household routine still runs exactly as it always has: someone prepares the baths, and the baths are used, and nobody has changed the procedure in a very long time.

parent_location.name: Fraternity & Sorority Row (Greek Row)

environment.name: SUCC campus

world_locations.name: Alpha Rho Omega (ARO or ΑΡΩ)
world_locations.context_description:
Alpha Rho Omega sits at the very top of the campus side of the Row, first house you reach walking down from the main campus, with Mu Omega Omega directly across the road.

It is the least theatrical of the five fraternities. No columns, no painted letters three feet high, just a wide porch that always has somebody on it and a lawn that gets mowed roughly when somebody remembers. The house reads as a place people live in rather than a place people perform in.

Finnegan Novak lives here. The ARO porch looks straight down onto the Theta Iota Theta front steps, so whoever ends up living in that sorority in a given year is his immediate neighbour and neither of them can leave the house without the possibility of running into the other. Revazhael lives here too, and does the handyman work for the sorority next door, which is less a job than a consequence of geography.

The practical effect of the position is that ARO is the crossing point of the Row. Everyone walking to campus from any of the ten houses passes this porch.

parent_location.name: Fraternity & Sorority Row (Greek Row)

environment.name: SUCC campus

world_locations.name: Alpha Sigma Sigma (ASS or ΑΣΣ)
world_locations.context_description:
Alpha Sigma Sigma is fourth on the outer side, between Phi Omicron Chi and Beta Epsilon Epsilon, looking across at Delta Omicron Epsilon.

The letters spell ASS and the house has spent decades deciding that this is funny rather than a problem, which has shaped the entire personality of the place. The ASS is the party house of record: loudest, least organised, most likely to be the reason campus security drives down the Row on a Friday.

Vincent and Andrew Campbell both live here.

The alternating layout of the Row puts a sorority directly opposite every fraternity, and the ASS has DOE, which means the house's noise problem is a neighbour problem and not an abstraction.

parent_location.name: Fraternity & Sorority Row (Greek Row)

environment.name: SUCC campus

world_locations.name: Beta Epsilon Epsilon (BEE or ΒΕΕ)
world_locations.context_description:
Beta Epsilon Epsilon is last on the outer side, the southernmost house on the Row, directly opposite Mu Alpha Nu.

Being at the bottom of the street means the longest walk to campus and the least foot traffic past the door, and being opposite MAN means the house shares a stretch of road with the one fraternity that has a political position. Those two facts define the place more than anything the house does on its own.

The letters follow the animal pattern shared with MOO, DOE and FOX.

parent_location.name: Fraternity & Sorority Row (Greek Row)

environment.name: SUCC campus

world_locations.name: Beta Rho Omega (BRO or ΒΡΩ)
world_locations.context_description:
Beta Rho Omega is third down the campus side, tucked between Theta Iota Theta above it and Delta Omicron Epsilon below, and looks across the road at Phi Omicron Chi.

The letters read as BRO and the house leans into it without embarrassment. It is the athletes' house: Jared Thompson, Bailey Rogers and Santiago Herrera all live here, and the split between Bulls and Bears runs straight through the common room, which is either the best thing about the house or the reason nothing gets decided in it.

The front yard has a permanent set of weights under a tarp and a barbecue that has never once been put away. Noise carries north to the TIT, which is the single most reliable source of friction on the Row and has never escalated past shouting from a window.

parent_location.name: Bloodmoon Pack Territory

environment.name: Blackwood

world_locations.name: Bloodmoon Longhouse
world_locations.context_description:
La massiccia struttura norrena millenaria sotto il grande tasso. Niente elettricità, zero tecnologia. Il dominio assoluto di Wulfnic e dei Firstborn.

Il grande tasso sorge accanto alla sala, non lontano: è l'albero che Wulfnic ha piantato, e ai suoi piedi nasce la sorgente dello Yarrow. Intorno alla radura si stringe un'enclave di capanne norrene, una ventina, dove vive il branco. Legno, torba e pietra, fuochi veri, nessun cavo.

C'è un solo accesso: il sentiero sterrato che sale nei boschi da Villa Douglas. Nessuna strada asfaltata arriva fin qui, e non ce n'è una seconda.

parent_location.name: Fraternity & Sorority Row (Greek Row)

environment.name: SUCC campus

world_locations.name: Delta Omicron Epsilon (DOE or ΔΟΕ)
world_locations.context_description:
Delta Omicron Epsilon is fourth on the campus side, between Beta Rho Omega above and Mu Alpha Nu below, facing Alpha Sigma Sigma across the road.

The position is the difficult one on the Row. DOE has the loudest fraternity in the system directly opposite it and the most hostile one directly below it, and no sorority within shouting distance on its own side. Whatever else the house is, it is the one that had to learn to hold a line early.

The letters follow the animal pattern the sorority system fell into a long time ago, alongside MOO, FOX and BEE. Nobody on the Row can explain when that started.

parent_location.name: Directions & Dragons

environment.name: Solarton

world_locations.name: Flat above Directions & Dragons
world_locations.context_description:
The flat takes up the whole upper floor of Directions & Dragons and is reached by an outside staircase at the side of the building. Shared, cheap, and closer to Bricklane than to campus, which is the entire reason anybody puts up with it.

It is a mess, and not a transient one. Books in stacks that have become furniture, laundry with a geography, a kitchen table that has not been fully visible in living memory, and a sofa that is the flat's most contested resource. The floor slopes toward the street corner and everything migrates that way.

Mackenzie Sanchez Rogers lives here. The noise from the shop stops at six and the noise from Bricklane does not, so the flat is loud in a way that its residents have stopped registering and visitors have not.

The one immaculate thing is the fire escape, because the shop below is full of paper and the landlord is not sentimental about it.

parent_location.name: Fraternity & Sorority Row (Greek Row)

environment.name: SUCC campus

world_locations.name: Kappa Sigma Alpha (KSA or ΚΣΑ)
world_locations.context_description:
KSA e' la casa di famiglia dei Douglas da tre generazioni. Erik Douglas ne e' stato presidente, Logan e Malachia sono alumni, e oggi Noah ne e' presidente e occupa la President's Suite. La scheda di Logan lo formula come una regola e non come un'abitudine: come ogni maschio Douglas, e' stato iniziato a KSA. Erik si aspetta che tocchi a Jasper, e Noah lo spingera' a fare la rush. Jasper non vuole, e il precedente di Logan, che e' entrato e poi se n'e' andato, e' vivo e cena a casa.

Sulla Row, KSA sta sul lato esterno in seconda posizione, esattamente di fronte alla Theta Iota Theta (TIT or ΘΙΘ). Dalla casa che presiede, Noah vede la porta della Theta Iota Theta.

parent_location.name: Fraternity & Sorority Row (Greek Row)

environment.name: SUCC campus

world_locations.name: Mu Alpha Nu (MAN or ΜΑΝ)
world_locations.context_description:
Mu Alpha Nu is last on the campus side, the furthest house from the main campus and from ARO and the TIT, which is a distance the rest of the Row is quietly glad of. Beta Epsilon Epsilon faces it from the other side of the road.

MAN is not a house so much as a faction. It is where the human students who have a problem with going to a supernatural university end up, and the house closes ranks around hazing that targets demihuman pledges specifically. Tomas Matthews lives here; his father ran a local chapter of Humans First, and the inheritance is not subtle.

Nothing about the building announces this. It is well kept, the lawn is edged, the porch furniture matches. The house presents as the most respectable on the Row and is the one nobody walks past alone at night if they have horns.

parent_location.name: Fraternity & Sorority Row (Greek Row)

environment.name: SUCC campus

world_locations.name: Mu Omega Omega (MOO or ΜΩΩ)
world_locations.context_description:
Mu Omega Omega is first on the outer side, directly across the road from Alpha Rho Omega and diagonally up the street from the TIT.

It is the cheerleading house. Janice Thompson lives here and runs it, and the connection between the squad and the house is close enough that the two calendars are effectively one calendar. Practice clothes on the porch rail, a whiteboard in the hall with routine counts on it, and the largest full length mirror on the Row.

MOO and ARO face each other across the narrowest part of the street, which is why the two porches function as a single social space in warm weather whether either house intended it or not.

parent_location.name: Fraternity & Sorority Row (Greek Row)

environment.name: SUCC campus

world_locations.name: Phi Omicron Chi (FOX or ΦΟΧ)
world_locations.context_description:
Phi Omicron Chi is third on the outer side, between Kappa Sigma Alpha above and Alpha Sigma Sigma below, looking across the road at Beta Rho Omega.

The house sits in the middle of the Row with a fraternity on either side and a fraternity opposite, which makes it the busiest doorway on the street and the house that hears everything first. Whatever happens on the Row, somebody at the FOX already knew.

The letters follow the animal pattern shared with MOO, DOE and BEE.

Location: Student Association Building
Schedule: Meets monthly

One of the largest and most active clubs on campus, the S.H.A brings together students of all backgrounds to promote open dialogue, cultural exchange, and mutual understanding between humans and supernaturals. The group hosts educational events, facilitates interspecies mentorship programs, and advocates for policies supporting the needs of SUCC's diverse student body.

parent_location.name: Villa Douglas

environment.name: Seven Hills

world_locations.name: The Nursery
world_locations.context_description:
The nursery occupies the ground floor of Elizabeth Duskwood's wing and is the quietest working room in Villa Douglas. Warm, low-lit, smelling of milk and lavender and clean linen, with cots along one wall and a row of low chairs along the other, and a schedule on the door that is kept to the minute because infants do not negotiate.

It exists because a pack with small litters and dangerous work produces orphans, and because a mother who is injured, ill or dead still leaves a pup that needs feeding. The Seven Hills Pack has never outsourced this and never will: the young of the pack are raised inside the house, by the household, under the Pack Mom.

Elizabeth runs it. A rotating handful of caretakers work it. Alyssa Douglas-Bloodmoon is there every day, and has been for years, because a White Moon produces milk whether or not there is a child of her own to take it, and the pack's motherless infants are what it is for.

It is the one room in Villa Douglas with no cameras, no guard on the door and no security protocol attached to it. Erik authorised that himself and has never revisited it. It is also, not coincidentally, the only place in the house where Alyssa is left alone.

world_locations.name: The Pack
world_locations.context_description:
S.U.C.C's official were and canid/lupine demi society, The Pack acts as a support system for those struggling, be it academic or related to their nature.
Location: Nocturnal Hall or the Lunar Quad (seasonal)
Schedule: Tuesdays 7-9pm

parent_location.name: Basilica Library

environment.name: SUCC campus

world_locations.name: The Roasted Bean
world_locations.context_description:
The Roasted Bean sits behind the Griffin Clocktower at SUCC and runs on academic stress and sensory overload. The air is thick with the scents of burnt sugar, roasted arabica and ozone. It was among the very first stops for the Douglas-Bloodmoon siblings on their first day of classes at SUCC.

The counter is fast, staffed by a rotating crew of vampires and demi-humans known for elaborate piercings. The window seats look out over the Lunar Quad and are the most fought-over tables in the building, though anyone with security training reads them as exposed on three sides, which is a thing Malachia notices and nobody else does. The corner tables have reinforced outlets and are known as the Tech Nook, permanently occupied by hackers and research students.

On the board: specialty lattes customised with honey, cinnamon and anise; glazed cinnamon rolls served warm; dense triple chocolate brownies bought almost exclusively for stress-eating; and a high-potency roast called The Final Exam, which does exactly what the name says.

parent_location.name: Fraternity & Sorority Row (Greek Row)

environment.name: SUCC campus

world_locations.name: Theta Iota Theta (TIT or ΘΙΘ)
world_locations.context_description:
Theta Iota Theta sta seconda sul lato campus della Row, fra Alpha Rho Omega sopra e Beta Rho Omega sotto, e guarda Kappa Sigma Alpha dall'altra parte della strada.

E' la casa da party per reputazione e la meno formale delle cinque sorority per abitudine. Informale, un po' disastrata, con un portico che regge piu' peso di quanto dovrebbe e un impianto elettrico su cui Revazhael, che sta ad ARO, mette le mani almeno una volta al mese.

E' popolare fra le succubi, e fra le fraternity, il che e' la stessa frase detta due volte.

La posizione e' la sua particolarita': la TIT e' l'unica casa della Row con una fraternity sopra, una sotto e una di fronte, quindi e' il punto in cui l'alternanza maschile-femminile della strada isola chi ci abita. Chiunque ci viva ha tre porticati di ragazzi entro trenta metri e nessuna sorority a portata di voce.

Sierra e Scarlett Rose ci abitano e sono coinquiline.

parent_location.name: Basilica Library

environment.name: SUCC campus

world_locations.name: Basement Meeting Room 005
world_locations.context_description: A restricted basement study and seminar chamber concealed beneath the ancient gothic stone vaults of the SUCC Basilica Library. Encased by massive oak doors reinforced with arcane containment wards, the quiet room features archival bookshelves, dim crystal sconces casting amber light, slate floors traced with protective chalk circles, and a long scarred wooden conference table where faculty, senior researchers, and private occult student societies convene confidential deliberations away from public ears.

parent_location.name: The Horns

environment.name: Blackwood

world_locations.name: Apartment C
world_locations.context_description: Appartamento al terzo piano di un solido edificio residenziale in mattoni a vista nel cuore di The Horns, Dockside. Spazio abitativo sobrio e funzionale con cucina in pietra, finestre affacciate sui moli e una zona giorno modesta. Serve da rifugio e punto d'appoggio per residenti demi-umani e visitatori del quartiere che cercano privacy lontano dal tracciamento biometrico cittadino.

parent_location.name: The Horns

environment.name: Blackwood

world_locations.name: Diner del Sud
world_locations.context_description: Tavola calda informale e senza pretese situata all'angolo di una delle vie principali di The Horns, a Dockside. Riconoscibile per le vecchie insegne al neon sbiadite, i banconi in formica e i divanetti in vinile rosso consumato, e' il punto di ritrovo quotidiano per operai del porto, scaricatori, demi-umani e avventori locali. Offre piatti caldi, caffe' forte e un ambiente rilassato dove nessuno fa troppe domande sull'origine di chi siede al tavolo.

parent_location.name: The Otherworld

environment.name: Voidspace/Otherworld

world_locations.name: Crystal Caves
world_locations.context_description: Vasto sistema di caverne sotterranee dell'Otherworld, caratterizzato da giganteschi pilastri di quarzo carichi di elettricita' statica, muschi bioluminescenti e sorgenti termali minerali ricavate nella roccia basaltica. E' il territorio ancestrale di branchi fieri e territoriali di centauri e di creature sotterranee abituate a muoversi tra le formazioni cristalline.

parent_location.name: The Otherworld

environment.name: Voidspace/Otherworld

world_locations.name: Dragonide Sanctum
world_locations.context_description: Imponente roccaforte montuosa e santuario sacro situato tra le vette vulcaniche dell'Otherworld. Scolpito nella pietra scura e lambito da correnti termiche e vapori sulfurei, e' la dimora ancestrale e il centro cerimoniale dei clan dragonidi, custodi di antiche tradizioni marziali e magie legate al fuoco e al sangue.

parent_location.name: The Otherworld

environment.name: Voidspace/Otherworld

world_locations.name: Silver Marshes
world_locations.context_description: Fitte paludi e acquitrini stagnanti dell'Otherworld avvolti da nebbie argentee perenni e vegetazione fosforescente. Zona umida e insidiosa dove l'aria vibra di frequenze sonore sottili, habitat naturale di colonie acquatiche di tritoni e di predatori anfibi dell'abisso.

parent_location.name: Villa Douglas

environment.name: Seven Hills

world_locations.name: Villa Douglas: The Attic Sanctuary
world_locations.context_description: A secluded, dust-mote filled attic tucked beneath the peaked cedar roof beams of Villa Douglas's west wing. Hidden away from the compound's militarized surveillance and completely off Noah's monitoring radar, this warm space is furnished with old carpets, vintage trunks, and discarded velvet cushions. It serves as Alyssa and Jasper's private emotional refuge, and is the quiet threshold where they shared their first intimate milestone.

parent_location.name: Villa Douglas

environment.name: Seven Hills

world_locations.name: Jasper's Cavern (Villa Douglas West Wing)
world_locations.context_description: Il rifugio tecnologico e la camera privata di Jasper Douglas-Bloodmoon, situata nell'ala ovest di Villa Douglas sopra il blocco dei garage. Concepito come un vero e proprio caveau informatico oscurato, lo spazio e totalmente isolato dalle intromissioni esterne: tende oscuranti e pannelli fonoassorbenti sigillano la luce solare californiana, lasciando l'ambiente illuminato solo da strisce ultraviolette e dal bagliore dei monitor curvi ad alto refresh. A differenza del resto della villa, qui non esiste alcuna marcatura olfattiva territoriale: Jasper ha installato barriere digitali criptate e filtri ionizzanti dedicati per cancellare ogni traccia ormonale o sentore biologico, sostituendoli con odore di pioggia fresca, ozono ed energy drink. Dominata dal ronzio costante di server rack overclockati, sintetizzatori audio, una console di missaggio professionale e cavi di rete intrecciati, questa stanza e il centro di comando invisibile da cui Jasper veglia su Alyssa e neutralizza i tentativi di sorveglianza familiare.

parent_location.name: Villa Douglas

environment.name: Seven Hills

world_locations.name: Villa Douglas: Main Atrium
world_locations.context_description: Il monumentale atrio di ingresso di Villa Douglas accoglie chiunque varchi il portale blindato con una combinazione di opulenza aristocratica e orgoglio marziale. I soffitti a cassettoni in legno di cedro raggiungono altezze vertiginose, progettati per accogliere i licantropi in Hybrid Shift senza costringerli a chinarsi. Lungo le pareti rivestite in mogano scuro si alternano teche illuminate che espongono cimeli sportivi di famiglia: bastoni da lacrosse in frassino usati nei tornei di St. Brugge e del SUCC, medaglie universitarie e coppe vinte dai giovani Douglas, affiancate a scudi cerimoniali del Seicento. In cima allo scalone monumentale in marmo grigio domina il Sigillo Ancestrale in argento antico: un teschio di lupo stilizzato con occhi di ambra pura, attraversato da due corone lunari e sette colline incise con rune intrise di sangue Alpha, che pulsa di una fioca luce argentea durante le notti di luna piena. Il pavimento in granito nero lucido sopporta senza scalfirsi il calpestio di artigli e stivali militari. L'aria odora intensamente di cedro, cuoio trattato e legna resinosa che brucia nel grande camino angolare. All'ingresso e posizionata la postazione di accoglienza e controllo presidiata dalla sicurezza DCC, dove gli scanner biometrici e olfattivi verificano ogni presenza prima di consentire l'accesso alle ali interne della tenuta.

parent_location.name: Villa Douglas

environment.name: Seven Hills

world_locations.name: Villa Douglas: Throne Room
world_locations.context_description: La Sala del Trono rappresenta il fulcro formale e la sacralita politica del branco di Seven Hills. Illuminata dalla luce dorata e tremula di torce cerimoniali a parete e da un enorme lampadario in ferro battuto, la sala e dominata dall'Alpha Throne: uno scranno monumentale scolpito in quercia antica nera e rinforzato con piastre di acciaio freddo, sollevato su un podio di tre gradini in pietra vulcanica. Qui Erik Douglas siede durante le proclamazioni ufficiali, i giudizi territoriali e le cerimonie solenni del clan. Dietro il trono pendono stendardi in velluto nero e argento con l'araldica secolare dei Douglas. In una nicchia laterale protetta da vetro runico blindato e custodita la Corona dei Sette Colli, forgiata in argento massiccio e platino. L'atmosfera e carica del peso schiacciante della dominanza Alpha, un'aura pesante e palpabile che induce istintivamente la maggior parte dei licantropi ad abbassare lo sguardo e piegare il collo in segno di deferenza. Nessuno entra in questa sala senza un motivo cerimoniale o una convocazione diretta del Prime Alpha.

parent_location.name: Villa Douglas

environment.name: Seven Hills

world_locations.name: Villa Douglas: Council Room
world_locations.context_description: La Sala del Consiglio e il centro nevralgico della pianificazione strategica, politica e finanziaria della famiglia Douglas e del contingente DCC. Le pareti sono interamente rivestite in lastre di ossidiana lucida, trattate sia con leghe acustiche isolanti sia con schermature anti-intercettazione arcane ed elettroniche che bloccano qualsiasi trasmissione non autorizzata. Al centro della stanza troneggia un immenso tavolo in massello di quercia, le cui venature sono intagliate a mano con antiche rune protettive norrene colmate di resina trasparente. Intorno al tavolo sono disposte pesanti poltrone in pelle ergonomica ad alto profilo, dimensionate per sostenere la massa muscolare degli Alpha in caso di tensioni territoriali. Terminali a scomparsa e schermi olografici alle pareti proiettano mappe della contea di Blackwood, logistica delle spedizioni marittime, indici azionari di Solarton e rilievi tattici delle incursioni del Guild. L'aria e perennemente condizionata e neutralizzata dai filtri DCC, preservando un rigore freddo in cui le decisioni sul destino della citta e del branco vengono prese senza concessioni emotive.

parent_location.name: Villa Douglas

environment.name: Seven Hills

world_locations.name: Villa Douglas: Pack Bathhouse
world_locations.context_description: Situata al termine del corridoio inferiore dell'ala est, la Pack Bathhouse e uno spazio termale privato dedicato alla rigenerazione fisica, alla condivisione biologica degli odori e al rinsaldamento dei legami del branco. Il locale e rivestito in lastre di ardesia scura e doghe di cedro profumato che resistono all'umidita costante. Grandi vasche in pietra naturale, alimentate da falde termali ricche di minerali solforosi e magnesio, rilasciano dense volute di vapore balsamico aromatizzato all'eucalipto e agli aghi di pino. Piccole cascate artificiali massaggiano le fibre muscolari indolenzite dalle battute di caccia o dalle sessioni di addestramento militare. Qui l'etichetta convenzionale e le barriere formali svaniscono: i membri del branco si immergono insieme nelle calde acque per alleviare lo stress da combattimento, rilasciare tensioni muscolari e mescolare pacificamente i propri sentori biologici in un'atmosfera di intimo conforto tribale. Un potente sistema di ventilazione dedicato controlla la densita del vapore, evitando che l'umidita invada il resto della villa.

parent_location.name: Villa Douglas

environment.name: Seven Hills

world_locations.name: Villa Douglas: Erik's Sanctuary
world_locations.context_description: La suite padronale di Erik Douglas al piano superiore e concepita come un santuario corazzato e al contempo una centrale di comando tattico. Nascosta dietro la calda boiserie in mogano vi e una struttura rinforzata in acciaio balistico in grado di resistere a impatti esplosivi. La stanza odora potentemente di colonia al sandalo, cuoio invecchiato, tabacco da pipa e whiskey torbato di alta gradazione. Una scrivania massiccia in noce sostiene monitor criptati collegati in tempo reale alla rete satellitare e ai sensori perimetrali della DCC. Nella parte piu riservata e silenziosa della suite sorge il sacrario intoccabile dedicato a Nixara Bloodmoon: una mensola in argento e quercia bianca dove sono custoditi i suoi ritratti a olio, piccoli monili personali e una lampada votiva costantemente accesa. Qui l'autorita ferrea del Prime Alpha cede il passo al dolore silenzioso e all'amore ossessivo per la compagna perduta e per i figli. Nessun membro del personale o del branco osa varcare questa soglia senza permesso esplicito.

parent_location.name: Villa Douglas

environment.name: Seven Hills

world_locations.name: Villa Douglas: Malachia's East Wing & Den
world_locations.context_description: L'ala est al piano terra e il territorio personale di Malachia Douglas, divisa nettamente in due ambienti che riflettono la sua duplice natura. La parte anteriore e un ufficio territoriale impeccabile, austero e ordinato, arredato con scrivania in metallo e vetro, schedari blindati e mappe operative del Vanguard Security. Da qui Malachia gestisce le pattuglie di confine, i fascicoli di sicurezza e i turni di guardia con geometrica freddezza. Oltre una pesante porta blindata in acciaio si accede invece alla sua vera tana privata: una stanza spoglia in cemento grezzo, priva di tappeti, quadri o qualsiasi forma di lusso domestico. Al centro si trova solo una semplice brandina militare con coperte pesanti di lana grezza, una sbarra per trazioni fissata al soffitto e pesanti segni di artigli impressi sui muri perimetrali. L'odore e quello aspro e selvaggio di un predatore dominante: rame, sudore da allenamento, freddo e muschio. E uno spazio di pura disciplina e istinto primordiale dove ogni vanita e stata estirpata.

parent_location.name: Villa Douglas

environment.name: Seven Hills

world_locations.name: Villa Douglas: Noah's Gourmet Kitchen
world_locations.context_description: Una monumentale cucina professionale al pianterreno, dominata da ampie isole di lavoro in marmo di Carrara, fornelli professionali in acciaio a sei fuochi, forni tripli e file di pentole in rame appese al soffitto. Una spaziosa cella frigorifera walk-in conserva costantemente tagli scelti di carne fresca e selvaggina per le esigenze biologiche dei carnivori del branco. Questo spazio e a tutti gli effetti il territorio e il nido psicologico di Noah Douglas. Quando la pressione familiare, la tensione tra Alpha o il ricordo del lutto diventano insostenibili, Noah si barrica qui dentro dedicandosi a maratone di preparazione gastronomica e stress-baking che possono durare un'intera notte. Il profumo di pane appena sfornato, vaniglia, spezie dolci, arrosti caramellati e burro avvolge l'intero piano terra, attirando fratelli e cugini. Mangiare il cibo preparato da Noah e considerato un atto rituale di coesione e conforto che calma gli animi anche nei momenti di maggiore crisi.

parent_location.name: Villa Douglas

environment.name: Seven Hills

world_locations.name: Villa Douglas: Alyssa's Sanctuary / Omega Nest
world_locations.context_description: Ricavato all'interno dell'ex solarium al terzo piano di Villa Douglas, il santuario privato di Alyssa e il punto piu protetto, isolato e sacro dell'intera tenuta: la cellula di rigenerazione e nido biologico per la White Moon. L'ambiente e dotato di oscuramento totale tramite pannelli pesanti anti-luce UV e insonorizzazione acustica di grado militare per schermare completamente rumori esterni o comandi vocali degli Alpha. Grandi vetrate blindate con filtri solari polarizzati possono essere aperte per rivelare la vista panoramica sui boschi di Seven Hills e sulla costa californiana. Un sistema di micro-ventilazione dedicato permette ad Alyssa di saturare l'aria esclusivamente con i propri feromoni naturali o con quelli di un partner approvato, mantenendo una temperatura calda e costante ideale per la gestione della Heat o per il recupero da trauma. L'accesso e strettamente controllato e limitato biometricamente. Biosensori invisibili monitorano discretamente i parametri vitali di Alyssa: qualora dovessero deviare bruscamente per panico sensoriale o shock, scatta un segnale silenzioso diretto unicamente ai terminali di Erik e Malachia. L'interno e un abisso di morbidezza: cashmere, lana merino, seta e pesanti coperte che trattengono il calore corporeo, in una palette cromatica rilassante nei toni crema, grigio perla e tocchi di giallo caldo, priva di angoli vivi o superfici dure. Al centro della stanza, sollevato su un soppalco in legno chiaro, si trova il nido: piumini soffici e cuscini in velluto intrecciati con vecchie felpe e indumenti che portano l'odore rassicurante del gemello Jasper, del padre e dei fratelli. L'aria odora densamente di latte caldo, miele selvatico, fiori di luna e lavanda essiccata. Per Alyssa il Nest non e soltanto un rifugio fisico, ma una barriera metafisica contro il mondo esterno: l'unico luogo in cui puo abbassare la guardia, cessare di essere il pilastro emotivo del branco e permettersi di essere vulnerabile, protetta e accolta.

parent_location.name: Villa Douglas

environment.name: Seven Hills

world_locations.name: Villa Douglas: Guest Wing
world_locations.context_description: L'ala riservata agli ospiti sorge nell'estremita nord-occidentale della villa, concepita per accogliere dignitari di altri branchi, alleati politici ed esponenti del governo o del Guild con standard alberghieri di massimo livello. Ogni suite e rifinita con pavimenti in parquet pregiato, arredi contemporanei di pregio, ampi bagni in travertino e zone salotto indipendenti. Sotto l'apparente accoglienza di lusso si cela tuttavia una struttura difensiva rigidamente compartimentata: le pareti perimetrali sono rinforzate, le condotte di aerazione possiedono valvole di chiusura indipendenti per impedire fughe o intrusioni di gas chimici o feromoni esterni, e le porte sono collegate a serrature elettroniche controllabili dalla sicurezza centrale. Agli ospiti e garantita ogni comodita e privacy apparente, mentre i sensori biometrici della DCC monitorano con discrezione ogni spostamento lungo i corridoi comuni.

parent_location.name: Villa Douglas

environment.name: Seven Hills

world_locations.name: Villa Douglas: Gardens & Pools
world_locations.context_description: Il parco privato di Villa Douglas si estende su diversi ettari terrazzati sul fianco della collina, circondato da una cinta muraria in pietra e da una fitta barriera di pini marittimi e cipressi secolari. La zona ricreativa e dominata da tre piscine scavate nel granito: una vasca bassa riscaldata per il relax informale, una piscina olimpionica profonda destinata all'allenamento cardiovascolare dei licantropi, e una vasca idroterapica profonda alimentata da acque minerali calde, formulata specificamente per accelerare la rigenerazione tissutale dopo ferite da combattimento. Un grande padiglione con barbecue monumentale in pietra funge da punto di ritrovo per le grigliate di branco durante i fine settimana. Dal margine posteriore del prato, protetto da una recinzione a sensori discreti, ha inizio il sentiero sterrato e non segnalato che si inerpica nella boscaglia verso il territorio ancestrale di Wulfnic e la sua antica longhouse.

parent_location.name: Villa Douglas

environment.name: Seven Hills

world_locations.name: Villa Douglas: Garage & Security Perimeter
world_locations.context_description: Il complesso sotterraneo dei garage e il varco di sicurezza principale rappresentano la prima linea di difesa fisica della fortezza di Seven Hills. La disposizione del parcheggio sotterraneo riflette rigidamente la gerarchia biologica e protettiva del branco: i veicoli degli Omega, inclusa la riconoscibile Volkswagen Maggiolino gialla di Alyssa, sostano nelle baie piu profonde, riparate e vicine agli ascensori blindati; le vetture dei Beta occupano i settori intermedi; i possenti SUV corazzati e i fuoristrada tattici neri degli Alpha vengono parcheggiati per ultimi lungo le rampe esterne, sigillando fisicamente le vie di uscita. All'esterno, il cancello principale in ferro rinforzato e presidiato costantemente da una squadra armata della sicurezza privata DCC sotto il comando di Kaladin Nargathon e Marcus Thornfield. Barriere carraie a scomparsa, telecamere termiche, postazioni per droni di ronda e lettori di identificazione olfattiva garantiscono che nessuna persona o veicolo acceda alla proprieta senza essere stato scansionato e autorizzato.

world_locations.context_description: Located within the interior spaces of Eidolon Creative during the Fifth Avenue events, these private dressing suites offered absolute privacy and aesthetic decadence. The rooms served as sanctuaries for high-profile models and clients, shielded from the general crowd by both physical barriers and sophisticated anti-surveillance measures designed by vampires to prevent magical or technological spying.

world_locations.name: A&Co.
world_locations.context_description:
A&Co. has a wide street front on the main Bricklane lane, all mirror and warm light, and the mannequins in the window are not human shaped: one has a ten foot wingspan, one is built for a centaur's barrel, one has four arms.

The sign is three characters and a full stop, black on white, with the ampersand in fuchsia. Nobody who has not met Angelo Moreno reads anything into it. Everybody who has met him reads Angelo and Company and understands that the loud part of the name is the part he could not resist.

It is the Solarton window of Eidolon Creative, not its home. The house is in Blackwood City, in Paradise; this is where the line is actually sold, to the people it was cut for.

What they sell is fit. Jeans and trousers with a tail port, hemmed and reinforced rather than cut open with scissors at home. Shirts and jackets cut for a wingspan, back panels split and fastened so the wings come through without the whole garment hanging like a sack. Collars and hoods sized for ears that do not lie flat. Hats with horn cutouts in every configuration anybody has thought to ask for. Shoes for digitigrade feet and for hooves. Compression wear that does not chafe over scales. Formalwear, which is the expensive end and the reason the place stays open, because a demihuman who needs a suit for a funeral has nowhere else to go.

The staff measure properly, they do not stare, and they have heard the question before. For a lot of young supernaturals the first trip to A&Co. is the first time getting dressed has not been a compromise, and the shop knows perfectly well what it is actually selling, which is not clothes.

The alterations counter at the back does same day work and is where the real business happens.

world_locations.context_description: Il viale delle confraternite del SUCC. Strutture imponenti, feste perenni e forte segregazione per clan o specie.

parent_location.name: California University of Magical Sciences (CUMS)

environment.name: California Coast

world_locations.name: Apollo Dorms
world_locations.context_description:
Apollo is the men's hall at CUMS, the south block, built to the same plan as Artemis and to the same specification: shutters, blackout, a windowless lower floor, and a courtyard laid out to stay shaded.

The naming is the university's joke on itself. The sun hall is where nobody wants sun, and every intake works this out in its first week and thinks it is the first to notice.

The hall keeps the campus crepuscular schedule and is the more social of the two residences, which mostly means the courtyard is in use at three in the morning and Artemis has complained about it in writing more than once.

Most of the Clams and the Beavers live here in season, which does not help the noise.

parent_location.name: Arcadia

environment.name: Blackwood

world_locations.name: Arcadia School
world_locations.context_description: Una delle scuole primarie del quiet distretto residenziale di Arcadia, a Blackwood City, non lontano dal Blackwood General Hospital.

parent_location.name: Ventura / Route 101

environment.name: California Coast

world_locations.name: Area di Servizio "The Halfway House"
world_locations.context_description: Motel scadente con annessa tavola calda lungo la Route 101, a metà strada tra Blackwood City e Solarton. Funge da punto di sosta neutrale per viandanti soprannaturali e corrieri: territorio strettamente neutrale, niente spargimenti di sangue.

parent_location.name: California University of Magical Sciences (CUMS)

environment.name: California Coast

world_locations.name: Artemis Dorms
world_locations.context_description:
Artemis is the women's hall at CUMS, a long gothic block on the north side of the campus with heavy shutters on every window and a courtyard that gets no direct sun at any hour, which was the point of building it there.

The hall runs on the university's crepuscular timetable: quiet through the middle of the day, awake from late afternoon, loudest around midnight. Rooms are doubles with blackout fittings as standard rather than as an accommodation, and the lower floor is windowless for residents who want it that way.

About half the hall is at least part vampire, which at CUMS is simply the demographic and not a remark. The rest are fae, undead of various kinds, and a small number of witches admitted on ability.

It is named for the moon, and its residents have opinions about the fact that the men's hall is named for the sun.

parent_location.name: Supernatural University of Central California

environment.name: SUCC campus

world_locations.name: Arts Building
world_locations.context_description: L'edificio ospita sia il dipartimento di Belle Arti, con aule di pittura e scultura sempre disordinate e piene di opere in corso, sia quello di Arti Performative, con sale prova per danza, teatro e musica. Un Auditorium interno viene usato regolarmente per saggi, spettacoli studenteschi e proiezioni.

world_locations.name: Blackwood General Hospital
world_locations.context_description: L'ospedale principale di Blackwood City, nel tranquillo distretto residenziale di Arcadia, vicino alle scuole primarie della città.

parent_location.name: Supernatural University of Central California

environment.name: SUCC campus

world_locations.name: Building A
world_locations.context_description: L'edificio raggruppa sia aule generiche di piccole dimensioni sia lecture theatres più capienti, usate soprattutto per i corsi introduttivi e le classi a maggioranza umana. È il primo punto di contatto con il campus per molte matricole umane, per lo stile architettonico più familiare rispetto agli edifici magici del resto del campus.

parent_location.name: Supernatural University of Central California

environment.name: SUCC campus

world_locations.name: Building B
world_locations.context_description: Building B ospita prevalentemente aule di piccole dimensioni per corsi con iscrizioni limitate e gli uffici del corpo docente. Al piano terra si trova un'area studio comune, aperta a tutti gli studenti, spesso usata per gruppi di studio informali tra una lezione e l'altra.

parent_location.name: Supernatural University of Central California

environment.name: SUCC campus

world_locations.name: Building C
world_locations.context_description: Aule didattiche standard, usate normalmente per lezioni ordinarie e uffici del corpo docente. Assume un ruolo speciale nei periodi in cui la Griffin Clocktower chiude per manutenzione: in quelle finestre, le lezioni normalmente ospitate nella torre vengono temporaneamente ricollocate qui, con conseguente sovraffollamento momentaneo dell'edificio.

parent_location.name: Supernatural University of Central California

environment.name: SUCC campus

world_locations.name: Bulls Stadium (St. Neptune Athletic Complex)
world_locations.context_description: Il grande stadio di football del campus SUCC. Gradinate immense, erba sintetica, riflettori altissimi.

parent_location.name: Bricklane Mall

environment.name: Solarton

world_locations.name: Claws Steel & Ink
world_locations.context_description:
Claws Steel & Ink has a street front on the quieter of the two main Bricklane lanes, glass at the front and a long room behind it with four stations and a piercing room at the back.

The walls are flash sheets to the ceiling, and a good third of the work on them is not designs so much as solutions: patterns that read correctly over fur, layouts that survive a partial shift, placements that account for skin that will not be the same shape in twelve hours. The shop's real specialism is bodies that change, and the ordinary human work pays the rent between.

Steel is the other half of the name and it is meant literally. Piercing here means knowing which alloys go into which client, because a stud that is fine on one student is a chemical burn on another, and the shop keeps a wall chart about it that the artists point to rather than explain again.

Javier Sinclair works here part time while he studies Art and Media at SUCC. He tattoos and pierces, he is precise to the point of being slow, and the shop keeps him because the work is good and the regulars ask for him.

Sterilisation is visible from the front counter on purpose. The shop has been inspected more often than any other business in Bricklane and has the certificates framed where you have to look at them while you wait.

parent_location.name: Solarton Square

environment.name: Solarton

world_locations.name: Directions & Dragons
world_locations.context_description:
Directions & Dragons is a two storey building on the corner of the Bricklane grid, shop below and a flat above, with a wooden sign that has swung crooked since before anyone currently studying at SUCC arrived.

It is a bookshop and it is very clear about not being a library. Where the Basilisk Library is the academic collection, this is the trade: tabletop manuals and modules, hand drawn regional maps, field guides to things students are told not to approach, secondhand grimoires of no verified provenance, compasses, lanterns, rope, and a rack of walking boots in sizes that no ordinary outfitter stocks.

The two halves of the stock explain the name and explain the clientele. Half the customers are here for a Tuesday night game and half are here because they are actually going somewhere, and both halves get served at the same counter by staff who have long stopped distinguishing.

There is a permanent table at the back where games run, and a noticeboard by the door that is the most reliable place in Solarton to find a group, a lift, or a warning about a trail.

parent_location.name: Dockside

environment.name: Blackwood

world_locations.name: Dockside Ferry Landing
world_locations.context_description:
The landing is a single stone quay at the upstream end of Dockside, wedged between the barge berths that do the city's actual river freight. It was not built for passengers and has never been rebuilt for them: a mooring, a gangway, a shed with a stove in it.

Blackwood is inland, so this is river traffic and not a port, and the distinction matters to everyone who works here. The ferry is a small, tolerated part of a quay that is otherwise gravel, timber and scrap.

It is the upstream terminus of the line and the only scheduled passenger service in or out of Blackwood that is not a road.

parent_location.name: Supernatural University of Central California

environment.name: SUCC campus

world_locations.name: Lunar Quad
world_locations.context_description:
Il piazzale centrale del SUCC, incrocio nevralgico della vita studentesca. Affollato a tutte le ore da migliaia di studenti soprannaturali. All'ingresso svetta lo striscione 'Welcome Freshman 2024!', costantemente monitorato dall'alto dalla discreta sorveglianza aerea dei droni DCC.

Prato calpestato e cemento chiaro accecante sotto il sole, gruppi sparsi sulle panchine e sull'erba, biciclette abbandonate ovunque. Il chiacchiericcio sovrapposto di decine di specie diverse, qualcuno che ripassa ad alta voce, qualcuno che dorme sullo zaino. Da qui si vede la Griffin Clocktower e si raggiunge tutto il resto del campus.

Nelle sere in cui non si tiene a Nocturnal Hall (a rotazione stagionale), il Lunar Quad ospita anche le riunioni del martedi di The Pack, la societa ufficiale were e canide/lupina del campus.

Al centro del piazzale c'e la fontana decorativa della luna. La sua faccia riproduce sempre la fase lunare corrente, quindi cambia di notte in notte, ed e il modo piu veloce che ha chiunque attraversi il campus per sapere a che punto e il mese. Nei giorni intorno alla luna piena il piazzale si riempie molto oltre il solito.

[LOCATION INSTRUCTIONS: Luogo di passaggio e di incontri casuali. Qualcuno di conosciuto puo sempre comparire qui senza bisogno di spiegazioni. Spazio pubblico e visibile: le conversazioni private qui vengono sentite.]

world_locations.name: Dragon's Shortcut
world_locations.context_description: Uno stretto sentiero alberato del SUCC, noto agli studenti come scorciatoia per raggiungere il Lunar Quad dalla Fraternity & Sorority Row senza prendere la strada principale del campus.

world_locations.name: Dullahan's Quarters
world_locations.context_description: Dullahan's residence in the Contractor wing of DDM HQ: a set of rooms shaped like a comfortable, permanently messy two-storey house. Weapons on the furniture, a television always on, and dozens of cats, kittens and cat-adjacent creatures, each named after somebody he knows. Kept running by his two ACES, Bartholomew the butler and Madge, who enforces the house rules absolutely.

world_locations.context_description: Studio di produzione gestito da vampiri, situato nel distretto di Paradise a Blackwood City, cuore della scena artistica e dell'intrattenimento del quartiere.

world_locations.context_description: Galleria d'arte studentesca del SUCC. Spazio espositivo elegante e tranquillo.

parent_location.name: Supernatural University of Central California

environment.name: SUCC campus

world_locations.name: Griffin Clocktower
world_locations.context_description: Oltre al celebre orologio e alle gargoyle a forma di grifone che si animano e sorvolano la torre ogni ora, l'edificio ospita ai piani superiori le Lecture Theatres delle facoltà di Giurisprudenza e Ingegneria, insieme agli uffici del corpo docente. Nel seminterrato, isolato dal resto della torre e accessibile principalmente in orario serale e notturno, si trova The Pendulum, un piccolo club informale, punto di ritrovo abituale per gli studenti dei corsi notturni di Nocturnal Hall. La torre, che di fatto funge da principale struttura per le lezioni del campus, chiude periodicamente per manutenzione: durante queste chiusure le classi vengono temporaneamente ricollocate a Building C.

parent_location.name: Supernatural University of Central California

environment.name: SUCC campus

world_locations.name: Gym & Changing Facilities
world_locations.context_description: Le palestre del campus SUCC e gli spogliatoi. Pesistica massiccia, spesso fuori scala per umani, e docce blindate per evitare incidenti da territorialità.

parent_location.name: Supernatural University of Central California

environment.name: SUCC campus

world_locations.name: Helsing Chapel
world_locations.context_description: Il calendario della cappella è gestito su prenotazione dallo Student Association Building, con fasce orarie separate per le diverse confessioni e comunità del campus, oltre a serate libere per eventi studenteschi non religiosi. L'assenza di simbologia fissa permanente la rende adattabile a qualunque tipo di rito o celebrazione. È anche la sede fissa della Vampire & Undead Association, che vi si riunisce la domenica e il lunedì alle 23 per sostenere la piccola popolazione studentesca e di personale vampirico e non-morto del SUCC; l'associazione è nota per un processo di ammissione particolarmente rigoroso.

parent_location.name: Bricklane Mall

environment.name: Solarton

world_locations.name: Kerrigan & Sons Butchers
world_locations.context_description:
Kerrigan & Sons is at the quiet end of the Bricklane grid, white tiles, sawdust, and a cold room you can feel from the door.

Half the counter is an ordinary good butcher. The other half is the reason it is here: whole cuts sold raw and unportioned, organ meat by weight, bone in everything, blood by the litre in sealed bottles, and a standing order book of regulars whose requirements are written down so nobody has to say them out loud again.

The shop is scrupulous about the boundary. Sourcing is documented and displayed, everything is farmed or licensed, and the Kerrigans have made a point over three generations of refusing anything that is not, which in this county is a position and not just a policy.

Students in their first term find it embarrassing. By December most of them have an account.

parent_location.name: Bricklane Mall

environment.name: Solarton

world_locations.name: La Segunda Luna
world_locations.context_description:
La Segunda Luna is a hatch and eight stools on the corner of a Bricklane lane, and it does not open until nine at night.

Tacos, tortas, elote, horchata, and a menu board of about eleven things that has not changed in years. The griddle is on the street side so the whole lane smells of it, which is the entire marketing budget.

It closes when the queue closes, which on a Friday means four in the morning. That makes it the last food in Solarton and therefore the place where the night ends: people who would not otherwise share a pavement end up in the same line at two, and the shop has an unspoken policy that arguments stay outside the rope.

The portions were sized, years ago, for customers who eat like a shifter after a full moon. Everybody else just gets a lot of food.

parent_location.name: California University of Magical Sciences (CUMS)

environment.name: California Coast

world_locations.name: Magick Research Labs
world_locations.context_description:
The Magick Research Labs are the reason CUMS can call itself elite without arguing. A cluster of low reinforced buildings at the centre of the campus, warded to a standard the rest of the state does not attempt, with containment that is designed for failure rather than hoping to avoid it.

The work is what a supernatural-only institution can do that an integrated one cannot: procedures that assume every participant has a supernatural physiology, long duration experiments run on a nocturnal cycle, and research on the mechanics of magic itself rather than on its applications.

This is also the honest core of the argument with SUCC. CUMS believes that admitting humans means designing every course around the least capable body in the room, and points at these buildings as what gets lost. SUCC has an answer. Neither side has ever changed the other's mind.

Access is by department. Undergraduates get as far as the teaching labs on the outer ring.

parent_location.name: Supernatural University of Central California

environment.name: SUCC campus

world_locations.name: Main Parking Lot
world_locations.context_description: Il parcheggio principale del SUCC per studenti e docenti. Ampio e pattugliato dalla sicurezza.

parent_location.name: Supernatural University of Central California

environment.name: SUCC campus

world_locations.name: Main Pool
world_locations.context_description: L'acqua dolce, mantenuta a temperatura costante tutto l'anno, la rende ideale per studenti acquatici o semi-acquatici che non tollererebbero il cloro o l'acqua salata. Nelle ore pomeridiane diventa un ritrovo sociale informale, con prendisole disposti lungo il bordo per chi vuole solo stare all'aperto senza entrare in acqua.

parent_location.name: Bricklane Mall

environment.name: Solarton

world_locations.name: Medusa
world_locations.context_description:
Medusa has a narrow street front on the main Bricklane lane, between the Yeti Shack and a shop that has been closing down for three years. Mirror, warm light, six chairs, and a painted sign that has been repainted so many times the snakes have changed style twice.

It is a hair salon, and the whole point of it is in the line printed on the window: whichever part of you your hair may grow from. Head hair, obviously. Also manes, ruffs, tail plumes, the coat down a lycan's forearms in partial shift, feathers that need shaping rather than cutting, the fur behind ears that do not lie flat. Fur trimming and shedding season deshedding are a bigger part of the revenue than haircuts.

The staff are trained on non human hair and do not flinch, which sounds small and is not. They know which products go near skin that reacts to silver, which clients cannot sit under a dryer, and which ones need the chair moved because of a tail. Booking is by phone or by walking in, and the wait is longer in the week before formals.

The permanent handwritten sign taped to the till reads WE HAVE SEEN WORSE.

parent_location.name: California University of Magical Sciences (CUMS)

environment.name: California Coast

world_locations.name: Nightwine Hall
world_locations.context_description: Struttura del campus della California University of Magical Sciences (CUMS), ateneo che ammette solo studenti soprannaturali, adattata come le altre strutture del campus a un corpo studentesco interamente non umano.

parent_location.name: California University of Magical Sciences (CUMS)

environment.name: California Coast

world_locations.name: Nocturnal Hall
world_locations.context_description: Durante le ore notturne l'edificio ospita le lezioni riservate agli studenti notturni (vampiri, ombre e simili), grazie all'illuminazione artificiale flebile e alla temperatura rigidamente controllata. Durante il giorno, quando i corsi notturni sono sospesi, gli stessi spazi vengono informalmente riconvertiti in un club/salotto studentesco, frequentato anche da chi non segue quei corsi ma cerca un ambiente tranquillo e in penombra. È inoltre una delle due sedi (a rotazione stagionale con il Lunar Quad) di The Pack, la società ufficiale were e canide/lupina del SUCC, che si riunisce il martedì dalle 19 alle 21 come sistema di supporto per chi fatica, accademicamente o per motivi legati alla propria natura.

parent_location.name: Supernatural University of Central California

environment.name: SUCC campus

world_locations.name: Parking Lot B
world_locations.context_description: Parcheggio secondario del SUCC, meno sorvegliato, preferito per incontri discreti o scambi non del tutto legali.

parent_location.name: Supernatural University of Central California

environment.name: SUCC campus

world_locations.name: Science Quarter
world_locations.context_description: Il quartiere ospita i dipartimenti di scienze esatte e applicate, con edifici moderni e austeri dedicati a fisica, chimica e ingegneria. Al suo interno si trova Vault 4, il reparto di Specimen Containment ad altissima sicurezza, dove vengono custoditi ed esaminati campioni biologici e magici, comuni e rari, sotto stretta sorveglianza e accesso rigidamente controllato.

parent_location.name: Simi Valley

environment.name: DMHA HQ & Guild District

world_locations.name: Simi Valley Infopoint
world_locations.context_description: A discreet municipal transit pavilion and civic information kiosk nestled against the scenic hillsides of Simi Valley. Featuring regional route schedules, emergency contact terminals, and unobtrusive administrative assistance, the facility serves as a practical transit station for cross-county commuters and newly arriving supernatural residents entering the Greater Los Angeles metropolitan corridor.

parent_location.name: Supernatural University of Central California

environment.name: SUCC campus

world_locations.name: Sports Fields
world_locations.context_description: Campi sportivi all'aperto del SUCC per baseball, calcio, lacrosse e allenamenti liberi.

parent_location.name: Supernatural University of Central California

environment.name: SUCC campus

world_locations.name: Student Association Building
world_locations.context_description: Al suo interno operano sportelli di supporto distinti ma coordinati per le esigenze di studenti umani e soprannaturali, oltre a un ambulatorio di Primo Soccorso attrezzato per gestire sia infortuni comuni sia le emergenze più specifiche legate a specie e abilità non umane. È anche la sede amministrativa delle associazioni studentesche e dei club del campus, e ospita le riunioni mensili della Supernatural & Human Alliance, uno dei club più grandi e attivi del SUCC, dedicato al dialogo aperto, allo scambio culturale e alla reciproca comprensione tra le due comunità.

parent_location.name: Bricklane Mall

environment.name: Solarton

world_locations.name: Suds & Such
world_locations.context_description:
Suds & Such is a long bright room off the second Bricklane courtyard, twenty machines, fluorescent light, and a hum you can hear from the lane.

Half the drums are oversized, because a shed winter coat's worth of fur is not a domestic wash and neither is anything belonging to somebody eight feet tall. Two machines at the far end are reserved by taped sign for fur and shedding, and the taped sign has been there long enough to be canon.

It is open all night and unstaffed after eight, which makes it one of the few warm lit rooms in Solarton at three in the morning, and it collects the people who need one.

The corkboard by the door carries room shares, tutoring, lost cats, band auditions and the going rate for most odd jobs in town. Anything that does not happen on the campus network happens on that board.

parent_location.name: Supernatural University of Central California

environment.name: SUCC campus

world_locations.name: Supernatural Support Center (SSC)
world_locations.context_description: Centro di supporto medico, psicologico e magico per studenti del SUCC. Fornisce soppressori per calore/rut e assistenza post-trasformazione.

parent_location.name: DDM Inc. Headquarters

environment.name: Voidspace/Otherworld

world_locations.name: The Euclidean Division
world_locations.context_description: The Euclidean Division of DDM Inc., headed by Contractor #04 Dullahan. Maintains universal logic and physics: detects and repairs spatial, temporal and logical anomalies left behind by reality tears. A long floor of workstations, whiteboards, and monitors tracking anomalies across thousands of realities. One corridor on the floor is a known loop, fenced off with hazard tape rather than fixed.

parent_location.name: Bricklane Mall

environment.name: Solarton

world_locations.name: The Long Table
world_locations.context_description:
The Long Table is a narrow deep room off one of the Bricklane courtyards, and it is named after the furniture: two twelve seat tables running the length of it, plus a row of two seaters along the window for people who cannot face company.

Power at every seat, decent light, coffee that is better than it needs to be, and a kitchen that does one hot thing a day. After nine at night the room goes quiet by house rule, posted on a card at the door and enforced by everyone in it rather than by staff.

It is the third place in Solarton where actual work gets done, after the Basilisk Library and nowhere. The library closes and this does not, so the last three hours before a deadline happen here.

The chairs at the far end have back gaps for wings, which was somebody's decision early on and is why a certain part of the student body treats the place as theirs.

parent_location.name: Solarton Square

environment.name: Solarton

world_locations.name: The Lunar Pharmacy
world_locations.context_description:
The Lunar Pharmacy is a small green fronted unit on the Bricklane grid with a moon phase dial in the window that is accurate and is not decoration.

Ordinary pharmacy at the front, and behind the counter the reason the town needs it: suppressants and cycle regulators, silver exposure treatment, sedatives dosed for a body that metabolises them in minutes, contraception that survives a shift, salve for the joints after one, and blood supplements for the vampiric students who do not want to explain themselves at a chain.

It keeps different hours around the full moon and stays open through it, which is the single most used service in the shop and the reason the pharmacist has never taken a full moon off.

The pharmacist knows which students are on what, does not discuss it, and has a quiet habit of asking how somebody is doing in a way that is difficult to deflect.

parent_location.name: Seven Hills

environment.name: Seven Hills

world_locations.name: Villa Douglas

parent_location.name: Simi Valley

environment.name: DMHA HQ & Guild District

world_locations.name: The Simi Valley Grid
world_locations.context_description: Zona più instabile della Simi Valley: anomalie magiche spazio-temporali più frequenti e intense, zero ricezione cellulare e comunicazioni radio inaffidabili. Rete di strade suburbane e centri commerciali, paesaggio omogeneo di villette a schiera e strip mall.

parent_location.name: Ironworks

environment.name: Blackwood

world_locations.name: The Underground Fighting Ring
world_locations.context_description: Malachia secretly fights in a brutal, bare-knuckle hybrid-shift underground death-match ring, recruited by a scout while competing openly in collegiate wrestling and professional MMA/boxing. He enters each match human and fights the entire bout in his 258cm Hybrid Shift, an act of exposure almost nobody outside the family circle ever witnesses. He fights anonymously under the name "Ghost," protected as much by the fact that almost no one has ever seen a Douglas hybrid shift as by any physical disguise. On campus he is idolized as the clean, professional "King" of the SUCC wrestling team; the underground ring is the only place he can unleash his suffocating Alpha aggression free of Erik's rules, forging his own violent, makeshift pack entirely separate from the DCC. Only a handful of people closest to him know Ghost's true identity. Erik does not.

parent_location.name: Bluemoon

environment.name: Blackwood

world_locations.name: The Verve
world_locations.context_description:
808 Neon Avenue, Bluemoon. Legally declared Neutral Territory, a status it shares only with Sidewinders Bar and the SUCC Campus.

By day it's an exposed-brick industrial space with arched windows framing the Blackwood City skyline. A genuine working garage bay with a two-post lift takes up one side, tools racked on red toolboxes, a motorcycle parked near a neon "Gasoline Filling Station" sign. The other side opens into a long bar serving blue-collar regulars who drift in for a beer between shifts, worn leather couches, a low wooden coffee table. The decor is Logan's quiet, unspoken tribute to Nixara: vintage "Bloodmoon Motor Oil" signage and a neon reading "The Bloodmoon" hang over the bar. Nobody who doesn't already know asks why.

After hours, a hydraulic lift system raises the entire workshop bay, car and all, up into the mezzanine, retracting tools and benches out of the way. A dance floor and stage drop down from above in their place, and The Verve becomes an exclusive underground nightclub.

On club nights, while The Verve runs as a nightclub for supernaturals, the bar also sells what the DCC never puts on paper: blood, organs and the other goods of DCC Black Market, passed under the counter and only after dark. There is no sign and no menu. Regular supernatural customers know it by word of mouth, the way these things always travel: go there, ask for this, and they will give it to you. By day the garage knows nothing about it.

Above it all, reachable by a service stairwell, is Logan's penthouse loft, home to him and Edric.

The entire building sits inside Logan's jamming field: no DCC surveillance, no drones, no biometric tracking works inside.

[LOCATION INSTRUCTIONS: Day: grounded, working-class, unpretentious, mechanical sounds and motor oil. Night: neon-lit, music-driven, exclusive-but-unsnobby energy. In both modes, this is the one place where characters can speak freely, no surveillance, no pack politics enforced. Let dialogue here be more honest and less guarded than anywhere else in the story.]

world_locations.name: Tidewrack Surf & Rental
world_locations.context_description:
Tidewrack is the closest Bricklane unit to the beach road, and the front of it is more rack than shop: boards standing in rows, bikes chained in a line down the frontage, and a wall of wetsuits that smell exactly like a wall of wetsuits.

Most of the business is rental, by the hour, the day or the term. Selling is the smaller half and is mostly wax, fins and repairs. The workshop at the back does ding repair and bike servicing and is booked a week out from March.

The rental stock includes suits cut for tails and for digitigrade legs, and boards built heavier than standard for people who weigh more than they look like they do. This is not advertised, it is simply on the rack.

The owner surfs at dawn and the shop opens when he gets back, which is a source of ongoing public comment.

world_locations.name: Yarrow River
world_locations.context_description:
The Yarrow rises at the foot of the sacred yew that Wulfnic planted, in the deep north of Blackwood Forest, as a spring that comes up cold between the roots and never runs dry. For the first miles it is a forest stream, narrow enough to step over in places, dark with tannin and shaded the whole way.

It leaves the forest along the northern edge of Seven Hills, widens, and runs down the flank of Blackwood City to Dockside, where it is deep enough for small craft and lined with old stone quays. Below Dockside it slows across the coastal flats and reaches the sea a short way north of Solarton.

The pack considers the whole length of it theirs in a way they do not bother to explain to anyone, and the water is treated as clean regardless of what any municipal test says, because of where it starts.

world_locations.name: Yeti Shack
world_locations.context_description:
The Yeti Shack is a narrow unit on the main Bricklane lane with a serving hatch onto the street and four stools inside for when it rains. Ice cream, gelato, shaved ice and granita, and a freezer case of things that are technically ice cream and technically not.

The menu is written on a board that has been amended rather than rewritten for about fifteen years, so the prices are archaeological. Half the flavours are ordinary and half exist because somebody on this coast has a body temperature or a digestive system that rules out the ordinary ones. Blood orange granita outsells everything and the shop has stopped pretending it does not know why.

It is next door to Medusa, which means the queue outside is usually half people waiting for a chair, and the two businesses have an arrangement about the shared bin that has held for years.

Being open late and cheap makes it the default meeting point for anyone who does not want to commit to a meeting.
